items.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: In the case of “Birdland,” that was Joe Zawinul’s really huge popular tune with Weather Report.

ctx.x: It was interesting to hear a completely acoustic version of Joe Zawinul’s tune, “Birdland.”

Oh “Birdland.” You know this recording came about because a fellow over there at JVC Records, Larry Hathaway. He called me one day about a year ago, I think it was about a year ago, he said, “Ray, I want you to make a record for us.” I said, well first I said I don’t know, I don’t think I need another record right now. And he says why. And I said well lots of my old things are being re-released on CD and so forth, and I’ve been recording pretty regularly for a Japanese label and so forth, and I said if I don’t…

of course the popularity, the thing is to do a tune that each guy either wrote or was associated with and made popular, like that. Of course in the case of Ramsey Lewis, like “The ‘In’ Crowd” it was one of his biggest things you know. In the case of “Birdland,” that was Joe Zawinul’s really huge popular tune with Weather Report. So one of the problems with that was trying to put it into a trio context and make it sound like it has got a sound. It had that effect. I think we got that.
